title: Edge Deletion
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 300; N-1 \leq M \leq \frac{N(N-1)}{2}; 1 \leq A_i \lt B_i \leq N; 1 \leq C_i \leq 10^9; (A_i, B_i) \neq (A_j, B_j) if i \neq j.; The given graph is connected.; All values in input are integers.
